description: This is a Java interface defining data access methods for ProductOptionValue entities, including methods to list, retrieve by ID, name, code, and store.

classes.name: ProductOptionValueDao
classes.description: A Java interface extending the generic DAO for ProductOptionValue entities, providing methods to query product option values based on store, language, ID, name, code, etc.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Returns a list of ProductOptionValues for a specific store and language.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a ProductOptionValue by store and ID.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ProductOptionValues by store, name, and language.

methods.name: listByStoreNoReadOnly
methods.description: Returns a list of ProductOptionValues for a store and language, potentially excluding read-only entries.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a ProductOptionValue by store and option value code.
